cases.C27: Not antisocial: the anchorite chooses containment. CISO-sober, memorable shorthand for capability held to granted bounds. Clear UK company; free .co.uk/.ai/.io.

cases.C22: Jurisdiction is the message, not offshore finance. CFOs and CISOs prize bounded authority; 'Labs' cleanly separates you from the IT services firm owning bailiwick.com.
cases.C30: "Provost" implies delegated authority and governance by consent—exactly the architecture of distrust. "Labs" signals product R&D, not university administration. Sober, memorable, ownable, zero shield-cliché.

cases.C24: Claustra turns containment into a virtue. Any echo of claustrophobia is repurposed as the security of a locked vault, perfectly mirroring the 'architecture of distrust' for regulated sectors.
cases.C16: Imprimatur's approval metaphor perfectly fits human-in-the-loop AI. Ecclesiastical baggage fades against clear domain availability and no direct competitor conflict. Memorable and sober.
